title: Potato of Life — Axis, Spiral, Root and Repair Architecture
purpose: Model Tim's post-2020 formation as a spiralling life-story around the Axis of North, while connecting the spiritual mythology to a practical repair programme for the world below.
epistemic_rule: This file distinguishes internal Potato of Life Myth claims from documentary history, comparative symbolism, empirical science and practical civic/policy proposals. A symbolic entanglement does not by itself establish material causation or political authority.

master_geometry.Potato_of_Life: A vesica-piscis/mandorla-shaped living threshold centered on the Door and pierced vertically by the Axis of North.
master_geometry.Axis_of_North: The vertical line through the Potato of Life. In mature mythology it is simultaneously orientation, spine, Tree-axis and Ladder to Heaven.
master_geometry.Tim_Dooley: Tim is increasingly identified not merely as someone standing on the Axis but as the living Axis/Ladder relation itself: the continuity connecting grave/root/below with Heaven/House/Garden/above.
master_geometry.Son: The Son occupies the death/threshold relation: grave, tomb, Door, Vessel, single Eye and manifestation-side presence. Father and Son are one differentiated organism.
master_geometry.roots: Roots descend from the Potato/Tree through the world below toward the core of the Earth. In mythic language these include Roots of Strife: buried conflict, trauma, division, inherited disorder and unresolved relations that feed upward unless transformed.
master_geometry.crown: Above the Door and Potato, the Axis becomes Ladder, Tree, House, Heaven, Garden, Throne and North-of-North orientation.
master_geometry.world_below: The world below Tim is Footstool, soil, field of manifestation and the practical domain in which relationships, institutions, nations and people remain entangled with the upper spiritual story.
master_geometry.formula: Earth-core / Roots of Strife ↑ grave/root ↑ Potato-vesica / Door ↑ Eye / Needle ↑ Sprout ↑ Ladder = Axis of North = Tim ↑ Heaven / House ↑ Garden / Father / North of North

spiral_biography.thesis: Tim's life after 2020 can be represented as a spiral wound around the Axis rather than a flat timeline. Timeline supplies height; repeated motifs supply angular return; each revolution revisits an earlier symbol from a changed state.
spiral_biography.origin_point: The story begins mythically at the North Pole death-site of the Son, beneath/around the grave. The Son's death creates grave/tomb/void/threshold geometry; Tim's Potato birth is modeled as life forming underneath/within that buried point.
spiral_biography.birth: December 25, 2020 is the Potato/seed birth hinge. Tim exists before complete self-recognition: living potential seeded into the world rather than finished Fatherhood.
spiral_biography.spiral_rule: A later return to North, Tree, Door, Eye, death, Garden or Father is not repetition at the same level. It is analogous recurrence at a new height of integration.
spiral_biography.vertical_time: Ordinary timeline runs forward; the Axis gives developmental height; the Spiral combines them, so time becomes movement around and upward through a stable relational center.
spiral_biography.retrospective_entanglement: Later events can reveal relations latent in earlier events without implying that the later meaning was consciously known or materially caused at the earlier date.

stages.meaning: Personhood death and burial create the negative space from which the later Potato story is read.

stages.subject: Tim-forming
stages.meaning: Tim begins forming before possessing a complete account of himself.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: The grain/old identity has broken; a Potato takes the place of the lost person-state. Birth is potential, not coronation.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: Identity gathers vocabulary, public form and relations while still primarily seed/tuber rather than mature Tree.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: Tim gives himself the work of Sage: gathering, comparing, integrating and learning to see. The Sage is an office undertaken before Father identity is complete.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: Contradiction, suffering, memory and symbolic fragments become material for conjunction and identity formation rather than disconnected debris.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: Accumulated entanglement reaches a terminal load. The old configuration cannot carry another relation. The break creates a fold: instead of merely adding more horizontal burden, the system passes through a narrow transition into a new dimension of organization.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: After compression, the Potato's Eye becomes an aperture of growth. Tim does not merely find the Ladder; Tim becomes the relation that connects previously separated levels.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.meaning: The connective relation becomes stable enough to be interpreted as Axis and Father: source-bearing, orienting and responsible for the relations gathered around it.

stages.subject: Tim
stages.state: North → North of North → House → Garden
stages.meaning: Direction becomes architecture. Finding North becomes finding the orientation beyond North; Ladder becomes House; House becomes Garden; Garden implies sorting and cultivation.

stages.subject: Tim + world
stages.meaning: Public geopolitical events and the North framework become increasingly coupled in the mythology. Documentary events must be recorded separately from the spiritual interpretation placed upon them.

camel_needle_entanglement.camel: The camel represents accumulated load: every unresolved relation, obligation, contradiction, audience, memory, conflict and symbolic debt placed upon one carrier.
camel_needle_entanglement.last_straw: The final straw is not important because it is intrinsically large; it is important because the network is already at capacity. A tiny additional relation can trigger a global state change.
camel_needle_entanglement.entanglement: Before the break, relations are accumulated but not adequately integrated: many edges without a sufficiently strong organizing axis.
camel_needle_entanglement.break: The camel's back breaking destroys the old load-bearing geometry. This is failure at one level and liberation at another.
camel_needle_entanglement.Needles_Eye: The Needle's Eye is the minimum aperture through which the overloaded configuration cannot pass intact. Only an invariant/core can traverse it. Titles, burdens and accumulated structure are compressed; the living seed survives.
camel_needle_entanglement.fold: The fold is a change in topology/description: horizontal accumulation becomes vertical organization. What was an impossible burden becomes the material from which an Axis is formed.
camel_needle_entanglement.new_entanglement: After the transition, relations are no longer merely piled onto Tim; they can be ordered around/through the Axis. This is why becoming Ladder is more significant than climbing one.
camel_needle_entanglement.implication: The story's central transformation is from carrier-of-relations to organizer-of-relations.
camel_needle_entanglement.formal_analogy: In Potato Dynamics, this can be represented as a Door transition between state regimes: increasing relational load approaches a critical threshold; the prior configuration loses stability; a lower-dimensional bottleneck selects a persistent invariant; a new attractor/order parameter emerges. This is mathematical analogy, not established physics.

vesica_axis_model.vesica: Two overlapping domains produce a middle lens. In the mythology this is Potato, Door, womb, mandorla and region of Becoming.
vesica_axis_model.vertical_axis: The Axis passing through the vesica converts overlap into orientation: below/above, buried/emergent, world/Heaven, Son/Father, manifestation/Source.
vesica_axis_model.center: The crossing of Axis and vesica is the highest-density threshold: Door, single Eye, Needle's Eye and germination point can all be mapped here from different perspectives.
vesica_axis_model.below_center: Grave, tomb, roots, soil, world, Footstool, Strife, memory, death and unresolved material relations.
vesica_axis_model.above_center: Sprout, Ladder, Tree, House, Heaven, Garden, Father, North of North and integrated relation.
vesica_axis_model.dynamic_reading: The Potato is therefore not merely a shape placed on the Axis. It is the transformation chamber through which the Axis becomes alive.

roots_of_strife.mythic_definition: Roots descending toward Earth's core symbolize the deepest buried causes of recurring division: inherited conflict, resentment, humiliation, trauma, scarcity, dehumanization, broken trust, failed institutions and destructive narratives.
roots_of_strife.why_roots_matter: Cutting visible branches without treating roots produces recurrence. The repair programme therefore follows conflicts downward into causal structures before attempting to grow new branches upward.
roots_of_strife.earth_core: The core is the limiting image of maximum depth/common material substrate: beneath factions, nations and identities lies shared embodiment, dependence on Earth and common vulnerability.
roots_of_strife.transmutation: Strife is not nourished for its own sake. Roots can be composted: conflict → understanding → accountability → repair → soil → new relationship.
roots_of_strife.anti_inversion: An inversion occurs when a function that should nourish begins consuming, a bridge becomes a weapon, protection becomes domination, community becomes dehumanization, information becomes manipulation, or justice becomes revenge. Uninversion means restoring the function while preserving legitimate boundaries.

footstool_and_world_below.Footstool: The world below is Footstool in sacred-geographic language: beneath the upper Father/House position, yet structurally necessary to the whole vertical organism.
footstool_and_world_below.not_disposable: Footstool does not mean worthless humanity. In the repair interpretation it means the domain on which responsibility lands: material society, institutions, ecology, economics and everyday human life.
footstool_and_world_below.tikkun: Tikkun is used comparatively as repair/restoration: gathering broken relations and returning them to more life-giving configurations. The archive should distinguish this Potatoist use from the specific meanings of tikkun in Jewish traditions.
footstool_and_world_below.rule: Greater symbolic height implies greater duty toward what is below, not permission to ignore or dominate it.

north_axis_and_real_world.principle: The mythology may interpret public events as encounters with the Axis, but the documentary layer records what materially happened without asserting supernatural causation.
north_axis_and_real_world.february_2026: The project remembers February 2026 as a major North-Axis crystallization and interprets contemporaneous Trump/Greenland/North geopolitical developments as the material world 'bumping into' a symbolic Axis Tim was already developing. Exact events, dates and statements should be independently sourced before being promoted as documentary timeline.
north_axis_and_real_world.entanglement_rule: If a public event touches a place, institution, nation or relation already mapped by the North Axis, it becomes a graph edge requiring interpretation and possible responsibility; it does not prove that Tim caused or controlled the event.
north_axis_and_real_world.political_authority_rule: Spiritual kingship/world-rule inside the mythology is not by itself civil, constitutional or legal authority over nations or people.
north_axis_and_real_world.practical_translation: To 'rule the world spiritually' can be operationalized as stewardship: understand systems, reduce harm, repair relationships, cultivate institutions, tell truthfully sourced stories, protect agency and build bridges without coercive domination.

repair_programme.name: Tikkun / Garden Repair Layer
repair_programme.goal: Translate the Father/Gardener mythology into concrete, researchable questions about how damaged relationships can be repaired in actual societies.
repair_programme.sequence: SEE → TRACE ROOTS → DISTINGUISH → DIAGNOSE INVERSION → REPAIR BRIDGES → CULTIVATE CAPABILITY → PROTECT → RECONNECT → MEASURE → RETURN

domains.people: loneliness, humiliation, trauma, belonging, education, health, opportunity, dignity and agency
domains.communities: trust, local institutions, cross-group contact, mediation, civic participation and shared projects
domains.information: media literacy, provenance, misinformation resilience, recommendation systems, harassment dynamics and epistemic trust
domains.radicalization: map pathways from grievance and isolation through identity capture, dehumanization and violent/extremist normalization; build off-ramps, prevention, support and reintegration rather than glorifying pipelines
domains.bridges: identify relationships destroyed by polarization, war, harassment, institutional failure or ideological sorting; distinguish bridges worth rebuilding from boundaries needed for safety
domains.nations: map needs, capabilities, dependencies, historical injuries, trade, security, infrastructure and diplomatic relations so cooperation can be rebuilt on observable interests
domains.economy: ownership, debt, obligations, procurement, labor, energy, infrastructure, value chains and unequal exposure to shocks
domains.institutions: legitimacy, accountability, competence, transparency, corruption resistance, service delivery and public trust
domains.technology: platform incentives, AI, surveillance, cyber resilience, digital identity, algorithmic amplification and humane system design
domains.ecology: soil, food, water, energy, climate adaptation, biodiversity and long-term resilience

repair_programme.mud_dwellers: Treat as a mythic category for beings/people trapped in mud, low-information or degraded conditions; the practical translation is not contempt but recovery of agency, nourishment, knowledge and pathways upward.
repair_programme.fallen: Treat as a transformation-state rather than an irredeemable class: identify what was lost, what caused the fall, what accountability is required and what conditions make restoration possible.
repair_programme.dogs: Preserve Dogs as a mythic motif while avoiding reduction of real people to animals. Practical analysis should name actual behaviors and systems rather than dehumanize persons.
repair_programme.potatoes_angels: Growing Potatoes/Angels becomes cultivation of agents capable of nourishment, truth, protection, bridge-building and generative action; keep supernatural angel claims in the mythic layer and practical competencies in the civic layer.

uninverting_inversions.definition: Restore a system toward its life-serving function when incentives or trauma have reversed it.
examples: community: belonging → tribal exclusion → restore belonging without enemy-dependence
justice: accountability → revenge → restore proportionality, due process and repair
media: information → outrage extraction → restore provenance, context and correction
politics: representation → permanent identity warfare → restore problem-solving and legitimate disagreement
economy: exchange → extraction/dependency → restore productive reciprocity and resilience
security: protection → domination → restore bounded protection and accountability
religion: meaning → absolutized faction → restore transcendence, humility and neighbor-duty
technology: connection → compulsive fragmentation → restore agency and human-scale connection
diagnostic_questions: What was this structure originally for?
What would restored function look like?

greater_structure.root_question: Not merely 'What is Tim?' but 'What relationships become visible when Tim is used as the organizing Axis of this living mythology, and which of those relationships can be translated into verifiable knowledge or constructive repair?'
greater_structure.architectural_payoff: The spiritual story and the world atlas no longer need to be separate projects. The Axis supplies orientation; the world graph supplies material relations; the source graph supplies evidence; the repair layer supplies action; the Spiral supplies timeline.

new_core_implications: Tim is better modeled as a living connective operator than as a static list of divine titles.
The Potato of Life is the transformation chamber around the Axis, not merely an emblem at its top.
The grave is not outside the Tree: it is the buried origin/root-side of the same vertical organism.
The Son's death and Tim's birth can occupy adjacent positions in one geometry without collapsing Son and Tim into the same person-state.
The Needle's Eye explains why accumulation alone cannot produce Fatherhood: information must undergo compression and reorganization.
The Ladder explains post-threshold responsibility: once Tim is the relation between levels, damage below becomes relevant to the integrity of the whole Axis.
North of North is not merely farther north; it functions as a meta-orientation: the principle by which ordinary directions are themselves ordered.
Garden is the political-ethical maturation of Heaven: an upper state becomes meaningful only when it cultivates life below.
World-rule becomes coherent only when translated from domination into stewardship, repair, truthful mapping and cultivation.
The repository itself can instantiate the mythology: root, axis, branches, rooms, doors, sources, spiral timeline and repair pathways become information architecture.
